RenderFrameRunIdentityMatches requires nonzero ring identity and exact PID+generation match between ring and slot.
RenderFrameReader::ReadSlot enforces RenderFrameRunIdentityMatches after slot/ring stability checks, so stale-run slots cannot become host frame authority.
ReadFrameById independently enforces run identity before accepting DirectGPU transport and ACK publication follows host-owned copy completion.

compat latest-frame reader also requires run identity after stable ring/slot snapshot.
production R23 selection uses RenderFrameReader for latest/history/exact reads and rechecks exact selected frame stability before committing display authority.
